desc: Shikari Devi Temple is a popular Hindu temple dedicated to goddess Durga in the form of Hunter's Goddess. The temple is located 18 kilometres from Sanarli in Karsog valley and at the same distance from Janjheli which is on the other side of the hill, through steep road to the temple in Mandi district of the North Indian state of Himachal Pradesh. It is believed that the temple was established by the Pandavas during their exile at the time of Mahabharata.

desc: Shali Mata Temple is a Hindu temple located on stop of Shali Tibba peak, which rises from Khatnol, which is part of Sunni in Shimla district, Himachal Pradesh, India. The base of the trek in Khatnol is about 36 kilometres from the state capital Shimla. It is about 7 kilometres trek from Khatnol to Shali Mata Temple.
